claims.engineering: 64/64 settings passed all three A3 seeds; 8/8 selected candidates passed all 30 A4 seed/F0 conditions
claims.method_comparison: structured and stratified-random search each occupied 13 behavior cells at equal budget

findings: B9-range controls can reproducibly populate multiple F0-variation and RMS-envelope regions without signal failure
structured search did not outperform the equal-budget random control in occupied-cell count
spectral-centroid variability changes with F0 condition and is not a pitch-invariant behavior label
reference proximity cannot be used as a monotonic objective because the known B9-over-B10 perceptual direction conflicts with some proxy improvements
next_decision: freeze a small diverse listening package but keep it not_queued while the longitudinal adoption-confirmation queue is active
